STRATEGY (set day 1): Kill everything I see EXCEPT criminals reported ONLY in hospital. Hospital (sector) is permanently excluded. If a criminal lists hospital plus any other place of mine (national, regional:South, radio, forum, foreign), killing him is still safe. Use quick entries, block afternoon only, for every kill. That gives about 9 kills a day: 1 national + 2 South + 2 radio + 2 forum + 2 foreign.
WHY: Afternoon-only deaths rule out day workers, so the pool becomes about 55k (x0.55). L reaches 3 of the 5 kinds. Excluding one kind entirely means that, if hospital is reachable, L can learn at most 2 of my kinds. The pool then settles near 3,400 (or 2,750) and I am safe forever, which happens with probability 3/5. If L learns 3 kinds, the pool falls to about 700-860 and I am caught. I accept that risk because 9 a day keeps the x4 multiplier (needs 40 deaths in 5 days; 9x5=45).
NEVER start killing hospital-only criminals. That could hand L a 3rd kind. Never do more than 10 quick kills a day. Never use morning, because that would also rule out students.
Expected pool at press conferences in the safe case: about 50-60k on day 3, falling to 10k-ish and then 3000. 'Pool 3000' staying stable means safe; keep going.
